title: Resolve a Merge Conflict
description: Merge a feature branch into the main branch and resolve the conflict that occurs when both branches modify the same line.

tasks.label: Complete the merge with a commit

hints: Both branches changed the same part of README.md. After starting the merge, inspect the conflict markers to understand what Git is asking you to decide.
A resolved file should no longer contain conflict markers. Once you are satisfied with the final content, stage the resolved file and complete the merge.
Use Git's status and diff information to confirm whether the conflict is still unresolved before finishing the merge.

intro.message: The feature branch has useful work, but both branches changed the same line. Merge it into the main branch and sort out the conflict.

startMerge.message: The merge has started. Git found changes that it can't combine automatically.

resolveConflict.message: Nice. The conflict has been resolved. Make sure Git recognizes the file as resolved.

completeMerge.message: Great! The branches are merged and the conflict is behind us.

success.message: Nice work! You handled the conflict and completed the merge successfully.

failure.message: The merge isn't complete yet. Check the merge state and make sure the conflict has been resolved before finishing.
